scope: Twenty-eighth bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved Sites meal-operations targets; three independently supported direct recommendations and five conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed or credited.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.selection_preimage_rule: The eight target IDs in packet order joined by LF with no terminal LF and encoded as UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Repository, family and adjacent-record behavior do not inherit credit.
methodology.reuse_rule: Exact target-key and cited-source-path collisions were replayed against every materialized Wave 4 through Wave 27 artifact. Repository reuse alone is disclosed and is not evidence.

GROCY.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Create, amend, remove, copy and mark meal-plan entries complete.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy meal-plan entry workflow at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The pinned UI performs meal-plan entry delete, create and edit requests, copies entries from one day to another, and marks entries complete after single-product or recipe consumption succeeds. The bounded claim excludes Site policy, audit, concurrent coordination, atomic consume-and-complete behavior and Oblivion runtime.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Apply recipe-driven food-stock consumption with validation, stock-entry updates and transaction history.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy recipe consumption and stock transaction service at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Recipe consumption begins a database transaction, calls stock consumption for resolved recipe positions, rolls back on exception and commits on success. Stock consumption validates existence, amount and available stock, writes negative stock-log rows and deletes or updates stock entries. The claim excludes Site isolation, multi-actor authority, Oblivion ledger semantics and runtime.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Calculate meal-recipe shortages and persist required shopping-list rows.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy recipe shortage and shopping-list generation at pinned loci
evaluations.evidence_loci: grocy/grocy@acd061e2cde09fc5bc4e34673021039b25ab7067 :: services/RecipesService.php :: L14-L74; public/viewjs/shoppinglist.js :: L146-L168; public/viewjs/mealplan.js :: L743-L797
evaluations.reason: The service resolves recipe positions, calculates missing quantities, then creates or increases persisted shopping-list rows. Pinned UI loci trigger missing-product generation. The claim excludes Site authorization, direct-object concealment, idempotent retry and Oblivion runtime.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Procure shopping-list items into controlled stock through a persisted purchase or receipt transition with provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy shopping-list stock-add UI and generic stock purchase service at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The UI opens a purchase iframe and reacts to an AfterItemAdded browser message; separately, the stock service supports generic purchase-type additions. The pinned loci do not provide an end-to-end server-side/controller/form bridge proving that the shopping-list workflow reaches that purchase command, so procurement receives no direct credit.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Apply a reusable Site meal-week template through a durable lifecycle.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy meal-plan week type and date-copy behavior at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Week-type constants and date-to-date copying do not establish a reusable named Site week-template apply lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Define and maintain durable named Site meal-week templates.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy meal-plan week type records at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The cited recipe types and single-date copy flow do not establish named template definition, management or durability.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Configure meal-budget limits, thresholds and approval controls.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy meal-plan weekly-cost display at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: Weekly-cost calculation and display do not establish budget configuration, threshold enforcement or approval.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Provide a permission-filtered multi-Site calendar overview.
evaluations.research_candidate: grocy/grocy meal-plan day/week calendar rendering at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: The cited calendar renders local day/week meal-plan views and does not establish permission-filtered multi-Site or global overview behavior.

collision_disclosure.precondition: All eight selected keys are current-map unproved with completion_credit=false.
collision_disclosure.target_key_procedure: Exact quoted working-key search across benchmark-target-specific-adjudication-902-wave4.json through benchmark-target-specific-adjudication-902-wave27.json.
collision_disclosure.cited_path_procedure: Exact path search across the same materialized Wave 4 through Wave 27 artifact set.
collision_disclosure.repository_reuse: Grocy was used in Wave 4, but only for routes.php and controllers/StockController.php. This packet cites no prior Wave 4 through Wave 27 source path. No family or repository inheritance is claimed.
